seo.title: Deployment
seo.seo_title: AI deployment: on-premises or in Quebec
seo.seo_description: An honest comparison of Nexora AI's two deployment modes: on your own server or hosted in Quebec. Who controls what, point by point, and how to choose.

blocks.role: Hub du déploiement : deux modes, qui contrôle quoi.

translation.headline: On your premises, or with us in Quebec.
translation.subheadline: Both modes serve the same principle: knowing where everything is. Here, point by point, is who controls what, and how to choose.

blocks.role: Les deux modes, résumés, avec liens vers les pages détaillées.

cards.title: On your premises.
cards.text: We install the system on your server, in your offices or at a host of your choice. The hardware, the access and the backups are yours.

cards.title: With us, in Quebec.
cards.text: We host and run the system in our infrastructure, located in Quebec. You buy no server and no hardware.

blocks.role: Tableau comparatif sous forme de liste : qui contrôle quoi.

translation.title: Who controls what.
translation.body: Eight points, from hardware to contract exit. In each case, the answer is written before go-live.

items.title: The hardware.
items.text: On your premises: it belongs to you. With us: it belongs to our infrastructure; you buy nothing.

items.title: The data.
items.text: On your premises: on your server. With us: in our infrastructure in Quebec, at the locations specified in writing.

items.title: The models.
items.text: In both cases: on the server concerned, or external only if you accepted them in writing. Each model shows where it runs.

items.title: The backups.
items.text: On your premises: wherever you put them. With us: at the locations named in the contract, with the list of subcontractors.

items.title: The updates.
items.text: Listed in both modes as outbound flows. On your premises, their timing is agreed; with us, we apply them.

items.title: Nexora AI's access.
items.text: On your premises: only what you grant, agreed in advance. With us: what operations require, described in the study.

items.title: The operations.
items.text: On your premises: shared according to the contract. With us: provided by Nexora AI with you.

items.title: Contract exit.
items.text: In both modes: your documents, configurations and workflows stay exportable.

translation.title: How to choose your mode.
translation.intro: There is no right mode in itself. These are the questions that steer the answer.

cards.title: How sensitive the data is.
cards.text: The more sensitive it is, the more physical control of a server on your premises is worth.

cards.title: In-house skills.
cards.text: Without a technical team, the hosted mode removes monitoring and updates from your workload.

cards.title: Hardware and space.
cards.text: On your premises, you need a server, a suitable room and network. With us, none of that.

cards.title: The investment.
cards.text: Buying hardware is an investment; hosting is a service. The cost of each option is estimated in writing after the diagnosis.

cards.title: Your customers' requirements.
cards.text: Some customers, public bodies in particular, may require hosting in Quebec: to be checked in each contract or tender.

blocks.role: Le mode mixte : à étudier, aucune offre définie.

translation.title: The case of a mixed mode.
translation.body: Some companies will want to keep sensitive data in-house and entrust the rest to our infrastructure. A combination of the two modes can be studied case by case. No mixed offer is defined today: so we do not present its scope or terms before studying it with you.

items.question: Which mode should I start with?
items.answer: The one that matches how sensitive your data is and your in-house skills. The deployment study compares the two options for your case.

items.question: Can we change mode later?
items.answer: Export of your documents, configurations and workflows is provided for in the contract. A change of mode is then planned as a project.

items.question: Does my data leave Quebec?
items.answer: It depends on the mode and the models chosen; we write it down before kickoff. An external model is never configured without your written agreement.

items.question: Is there an offline mode?
items.answer: We do not promise operation with no outbound flow at all: updates and licences are listed. Running with no outbound flow is decided and verified case by case.

translation.title: Let's choose your mode together.
translation.text: A deployment study compares the two options for your case: data, skills, hardware, your customers' requirements.
